evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: We introduce Lab2Sim, a benchmark of 218 science experiment videos with evidence-grounded specifications and 11,881 rubric items.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: To address this task, we propose EduVideo2Code, which extracts experimental procedures hierarchically, encodes them as explicit state machines to guide code generation, and refines the resulting pages through execution-based verification.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: EduVideo2Code consistently improves all four evaluation dimensions across two backbone models, with apparatus fidelity gains of 24.15 points.
